verdict.rationale: E2B's quickstart says every new account gets $100 in credits, and the docs describe a Base tier alongside Pro. The quickstart walks developers straight from an API key to running sandbox code, so they can self-serve without a sales conversation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the credits and self-serve signup, and explicit documentation of signup requirements (e.g., card needed or not) and Base-tier limits beyond session length.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building with a free tier or included credits without talking to sales

citations.quote: Every new E2B account get $100 in credits.
Sandboxes can run continuously for up to 24 hours (Pro) or 1 hour (Base).
